title: E0041: Unreachable Code
plain_english: Reports statements that cannot be reached.
why_matters: Unreachable code often indicates a logic error, dead branch, or leftover code after a control-flow change. This rule uses Phanalist's bounded formal verification engine (Z3-backed) to identify statements that cannot be executed on feasible paths.
bad_example:
<?php
function f(): int
{
    return 1;
    echo "never"; // unreachable
}
good_example:
<?php
function f(): int
{
    echo "before return";
    return 1;
}
what_it_checks: Conditional throws and exits that only make one branch unreachable
